description: This file contains unit tests for route access control and authorization logic in the litellm proxy module, focusing on permissions, route validation, and access restrictions.

classes.name: LiteLLM_UserTable
classes.description: Represents user data including ID, email, and role.

classes.name: UserAPIKeyAuth
classes.description: Represents user API key authentication info, including allowed routes and metadata.

methods.name: test_non_admin_config_update_route_rejected()
methods.description: Tests that non-admin users are rejected for the /config/update route.

methods.name: test_proxy_admin_viewer_config_update_route_rejected()
methods.description: Tests that proxy admin viewer users are rejected for the /config/update route.

methods.name: test_virtual_key_allowed_routes_with_litellm_routes_member_name_allowed()
methods.description: Verifies that routes allowed by LiteLLMRoutes enum are permitted for virtual keys.

methods.name: test_virtual_key_allowed_routes_with_litellm_routes_member_name_denied()

methods.name: test_virtual_key_llm_api_route_includes_passthrough_prefix(route)
methods.description: Ensures routes with certain prefixes are allowed for virtual keys with llm_api_routes permission.

methods.name: test_virtual_key_llm_api_routes_allows_google_routes(route)
methods.description: Validates access to Google AI routes for virtual keys with llm_api_routes permission.

methods.name: test_virtual_key_allowed_routes_with_multiple_litellm_routes_member_names()

methods.name: test_anthropic_count_tokens_route_accessible_to_internal_users()

methods.description: Tests access to registered pass-through endpoints for virtual keys with llm_api_routes permission.

methods.name: test_virtual_key_without_llm_api_routes_cannot_access_pass_through()
methods.description: Checks that virtual keys without permission cannot access pass-through routes.
